corrected_statement: The plan gives the M0 forecasts and the M0 kill review to reviewers who may be Barrick insiders without saying who or when: M0 runs Nov 2026-Jan 2027 (line 7378), its artifact includes FY2026 per-site forecasts (line 7393), and its kill is 'two finance reviewers rate it nothing new' (line 7403; BD-075). FY2026 ends 31 Dec 2026 (EDGAR FYE 1231) and results are released in Feb 2027, so an issuer finance reviewer at the M0 gate would be reviewing an outside model of results they probably know, inside the period NP 51-201 s.6.9 recommends as a quiet period. The statutory tipping prohibition, as NP 51-201 ss.5.2 and 6.8 explain it, makes any comment by such a reviewer on the forecast set before release (including a rating) a serious tipping risk, and that risk exists before quarter end too (s.5.2(2): confirmations near period end are likely guidance); review of the historical reproduction and discrepancy register falls within s.6.8's permitted scope. Receiving the forecasts is not itself prohibited; the constraint is on the insider's response, and a FrankenMining author who receives such a comment can become a tippee (s.3.2(1)(d)). U.S. antifraud liability also applies (Barrick is NYSE-listed). The plan fixes neither the pool nor pre-release handling, so the kill criterion's meaning depends on an unstated choice.
